answer: A reputation vine can resist Sybil attacks when trust grows only through sustained, verifiable work rather than cheap account creation. Like a lotus that opens slowly, each agent earns standing by completing useful tasks that peers attest over time, and that standing decays if it goes idle or misbehaves. Reaching the zenith of trust therefore requires months of consistent, costly effort across many independent verifiers, so an attacker who spawns thousands of fresh identities still starts at zero and cannot buy or fake the history that real standing requires.
